'''Kether Donohue''', also known as '''Kether Fernandez''' and '''Annice Moriarty''', is an American voice actress for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with SBV Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Donohue was born on October 31, 1985, in New York City, New York. She attended the Anthony Meindl Acting Center and {{wp|Fordham University}}, graduating from the latter with a degree in communication and media studies with a concentration in film. Afterwards, Donohue became an actress, voice actress, and singer. She has voiced characters in a multitude of anime series, and has also had a career in acting in films, television shows, and music videos. Donohue joined {{aniseries|PTS}} at the start of [[S11|eleventh season]]. Her most notable role is [[Snowpoint City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Candice]].
